text:
Situation: Fludarabine phosphate has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-05-06 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 15 vials of 50 mg/2 mL (4.4 days) and 18 vials of 25 mg/mL (4.1 days). Corvale General holds 82 vials of 50 mg/2 mL (18.2 days) and 53 vials of 25 mg/mL (12.2 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 6 vials of 50 mg/2 mL (6.3 days). The product used at Corvale General and Corvale East carries NDC 45963060955 labeled by Actavis Pharma, Inc., naming ACTAVIS TOTOWA as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1142104 at the associated facility (FEI 3004762406, NerPharMa S.r.l.) ended 2020-01-17 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2021-05-19 — 840 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2022-05-06. No FDA inspection at a registered plant for this product occurred after the shortage posting, so the record shows a VAI classification well before the posting but no later action tied to the shortage.

Our position: Corvale General can spare 18 vials of 50 mg/2 mL while retaining a two‑week supply, raising Corvale East from 4.4 days to about 10 days. Alternate manufacturers Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (plant last inspected VAI 2023-08-24), Hisun Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., Lannett Company, Inc., and Sagent Pharmaceuticals are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 18 vials of 50 mg/2 mL, 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — requires buyer approval.
3. Purchase from Hisun Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. — requires buyer approval.
4. Purchase from Lannett Company, Inc. — requires buyer approval.
5. Purchase from Sagent Pharmaceuticals — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No other actions at this time.
